questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Comoros?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Comoros article.

questions.proof: The capital is Moroni on Grande Comore.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Comoros?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the Comoros article.

questions.proof: The islands are officially known by their Comorian language names.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Mayotte is also a territory that is claimed by Comoros but is a part of _____ as an oversea territory.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “part”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Comoros article.

questions.proof: Mayotte is also a territory that is claimed by Comoros but is a part of France as an oversea territory.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “It is between _____ and mainland Africa.”

hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Comoros article.

questions.proof: It is between Madagascar and mainland Africa.

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “between”. It names one thing, not an action.
